debrief db-021
1) the actor d-r-a-f-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s for the t-h-r-e-e b-i-d-d-e-r s-i-d-e-s and l-e-f-t a s-h-a-r-e-d f-o-l-d-e-r t-r-e-e in the n-e-t-w-o-r-k s-h-a-r-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e l-e-g-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
2) the actor c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d the h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n t-a-b-l-e s-h-o-w-i-n-g side p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s and l-e-f-t a c-r-y-p-t-e-d s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t on a p-e-r-s-o-n-a-l d-r-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e.
3) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d the s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g w-o-r-k-s-h-e-e-t-s between the t-h-r-e-e o-r-g-a-n-i-z-a-t-i-o-n-s via e-m-a-i-l a-l-i-a-s-e-s and l-e-f-t a m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a l-o-g on the m-a-i-l s-e-r-v-e-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-a-t-a h-a-n-d-l-i-n-g r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) the actor s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-d the w-i-n-n-i-n-g r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e across the r-o-u-n-d-s in a c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r f-i-l-e and l-e-f-t a s-y-n-c r-e-c-o-r-d on a c-l-o-u-d d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g c-h-e-c-k.
5) the actor m-i-r-r-o-r-e-d the a-g-g-r-e-g-a-t-e-d a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t in a w-h-a-t-s-a-p-p-s t-h-r-e-a-d to m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n the a-p-p-e-a-r-a-n-c-e of c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a c-h-a-t e-x-p-o-r-t on a m-o-b-i-l-e d-e-v-i-c-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-c-o-r-d r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w.
